turns.question: How many orders of more than 100 EUR were placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer cannot answer this as asked: its order-amount filter accepts only exact values, so it cannot count orders above 100 EUR, and the threshold query returned a tool error, so I give no figure. The closest metric is Orders (orders_total, all orders placed, cancelled included), and Revenue (revenue_eur) is the other option, but neither counts orders over an amount.
